#| include: false

# ---------- code chunks
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 8,
                      out.width = "100%",
                      collapse  = TRUE, 
                      comment   = "#>",
                      message   = FALSE, 
                      cache     = FALSE, 
                      error     = FALSE,
                      tidy      = FALSE, 
                      echo      = TRUE)



# ---------- backups that reset at common wrap-up
oldseed <- NULL
if (exists(".Random.seed")) oldseed <- .Random.seed

my_options <- options()



# ---------- format inline large numbers with comma separators
knitr::knit_hooks$set(inline = function(x) {
    if (!is.numeric(x)) {
        x
    } else if (x >= 10000) {
        prettyNum(round(x, 2), big.mark = ",")
    } else {
        prettyNum(round(x, 2))
    }
})



# ---------- data.table display
options(
    datatable.print.nrows = 6,   # print all rows up to this N
    datatable.print.topn  = 3,   # otherwise this N top/bottom
    datatable.print.class = TRUE # print class of variable
)
